name: vcm-mcp
description: Token-aware compaction of .vcm/history.json into SKILL.md, plus read/write of SKILL.md. Runs locally; the summarizer call goes to any OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

project_dir.title: Project directory
project_dir.description: Directory holding .vcm/history.json and SKILL.md. Defaults to the working directory.

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: Key for the OpenAI-compatible endpoint used by compact_memory. Not needed for the file tools.

tools.name: get_token_status
tools.description: Token usage of .vcm/history.json against the context window.

tools.name: compact_memory
tools.description: Summarize the oldest history into SKILL.md format until it fits target_percent% of its token size.
